title: 第680章 老神仙日常680第679章 老神仙日常679
content_zh:
韩烈惯性地冲出去了十几步，没听见身后传来脚步声，却听见了不少打斗声，他咬紧了牙关，转头往回跑。
当他捡起了一根铁棒，冲到林彦廷身边时，林彦廷正一脚将最后一个混混踹倒。
“你、你……”韩烈话还没说完，便见这姓林的上去又补了两棍，那混混抱着头躺在了地上。
发现这些混混躺在地上完全起不来，韩烈觉的自己捡到了宝，只是这宝是个很不好惹的人。
他吞了口口水，闭上了半天合不上的嘴巴。
林彦廷活动了一下肩膀，眯着眼睛回头去看韩烈，从喉咙里挤出一声，“报警。”
“不能报警！”韩烈握紧了手中的铁棒子，看着躺了一地的人，他用力摇了摇头，扭脸看向林彦廷时又扬起了个大大的笑脸来，“真的不能报警~”
林彦廷闭了闭眼睛，睁眼时剜了韩烈一眼，“在我面前，不用这样。”
说了这话，他挥了挥手中的铁棒，率先朝前走去。
韩烈仍然握着手中的铁棒，观察着躺在地上的人，倒退着跟在林彦廷身后，直到确定那些人毫无还手之力了，“嗙铛”一声，他丢掉了铁棒，疾步追了过去。
林彦廷咂了咂嘴，停下了脚步，回身看着韩烈，“捡回来。”
“啊？”韩烈半张着口，回眸去看，却不知道林彦廷要自己捡什么回来。
林彦廷用下巴指了指那根铁棒，“捡回来。”
韩烈“哦”了一声，眼睛盯着地上的那群人，啪嗒啪嗒地跑了过去，捡了铁棒回来，却发现林彦廷满眼笑意的看着自己。
一阵愣怔，他眨了眨眼睛，“怎么了？干嘛看着我笑？”
林彦廷哼笑着摇了摇头，转身朝前走去。
韩烈跟了上去，小心翼翼地问道：“现在去哪里？”
林彦廷“嗯？”了一声，再次停下了脚步，他转眸看了过去，“你还不回家去？”
“我……”韩烈用力摇了摇头，抿唇露出个笑来，“哎~，没想到你身手这么好呢？！”
林彦廷用舌尖舔了舔后槽牙，“我也没想到。”

“什么？”韩烈满眼笑意地盯着林彦廷的脸，“没想到什么？”
林彦廷“哼”了一声，“没什么。”
“咱们都一起打过架了，什么没什么？”韩烈不满地敲了林彦廷胳膊一拳。
林彦廷又“哼”了一声，抬手揉了揉被敲到的地方。
“怎么了？”韩烈停下了脚步，想到了刚才的那场架，他皱起眉来，避开了刚才敲到的地方，拉着林彦廷站在了原处，伸手去撸林彦廷的袖子，“疼吗？”
林彦廷皱着眉头抽回了自己的胳膊，将衬衫袖扣扣了回去，抬眸看着韩烈，缓缓呼出了一口气。
韩烈舔了舔唇，立刻垂下了眸子，“对不起，我给你添麻烦了……”
“过分自责，这也是抑郁症的表现之一。”林彦廷抬起手指，隔空点了点韩烈，“要注意控制。”
韩烈“嗯？”了一声，抬起眼眸看向了林彦廷。
“我闲着没事，打了一架而已。”林彦廷勾唇露出个笑来，“压力大，总要找些机会发泄出去。”
“压力大？”韩烈睁圆了眼睛，“你压力很大吗？”
林彦廷点了点头，“烈少，时间真的不早了，你要不要先回家去……”说着话，他用下巴点了点远处那些被人丢在地上的摩托车，“先解决一下问题。”
韩烈回头望了一眼，迟疑了一下，立刻摇头，“我送你去医院。”
“医院？”林彦廷轻轻蹙眉，哼笑着摇了摇手中的铁棒。
content_en:
Han Lie rushed out for more than ten steps with inertia. He didn't hear the footsteps behind him, but he heard a lot of fighting sounds. He gritted his teeth, turned around and ran back.
When he picked up an iron rod and rushed to Lin Yanting's side, Lin Yanting was kicking the last gangster down.
"You, you..." Before Han Lie could finish his words, he saw the man surnamed Lin went up to mend two more sticks, and the gangster lay on the ground holding his head.
Finding these gangsters lying on the ground unable to get up, Han Lie felt that he had picked up a treasure, but this treasure was a very difficult person to mess with.
He swallowed and closed his mouth, which he couldn't close for a long time.
Lin Yanting moved his shoulders, squinted his eyes and looked back at Han Lie, then squeezed out a cry from his throat, "Call the police."
"You can't call the police!" Han Lie clenched the iron rod in his hand and looked at the people lying on the ground. He shook his head vigorously and turned to look at Lin Yanting with a big smile on his face. "You really can't call the police~"
Lin Yanting closed his eyes and glanced at Han Lie when he opened them, "You don't have to do this in front of me."
After saying this, he waved the iron rod in his hand and walked forward first.
Han Lie still held the iron rod in his hand, observing the people lying on the ground, and followed Lin Yanting backwards until he was sure that those people had no power to fight back. With a "pop", he dropped the iron rod and chased after them quickly.
Lin Yanting smacked his lips, stopped, turned around and looked at Han Lie, "Pick it back."
"Ah?" Han Lie half-opened his mouth and looked back, but he didn't know what Lin Yanting wanted to pick up.
Lin Yanting pointed to the iron rod with his chin, "Pick it back."
Han Lie said "Oh", stared at the group of people on the ground, ran over, picked up the iron bar, and came back, only to find Lin Yanting looking at him with a smile on his face.
He was stunned for a while, then blinked, "What's wrong? Why are you looking at me and smiling?"
Lin Yanting smiled and shook his head, turned around and walked forward.
Han Lie followed and asked cautiously: "Where are we going now?"
Lin Yanting said "Huh?" and stopped again. He turned his eyes and looked over, "Aren't you going home?"
"I..." Han Lie shook his head vigorously, pursed his lips and smiled, "Hey~, I didn't expect you to be so skilled?!"
Lin Yanting licked his back molars with the tip of his tongue, "I didn't expect it either."
"What?" Han Lie stared at Lin Yanting's face with a smile on his face, "What didn't you expect?"
Lin Yanting hummed, "It's nothing."
"We've all fought together, what's the big deal?" Han Lie punched Lin Yanting's arm in dissatisfaction.
Lin Yanting hummed again and raised his hand to rub the hit area.
"What's wrong?" Han Lie stopped and thought of the fight just now. He frowned and avoided the place where he had just hit. He pulled Lin Yanting to stand where he was and reached out to roll up Lin Yanting's sleeves. "Does it hurt?"
Lin Yanting frowned and withdrew his arm, buttoned back the cuff buttons of his shirt, raised his eyes to look at Han Lie, and slowly exhaled.
Han Lie licked his lips and immediately lowered his eyes, "I'm sorry, I caused you trouble..."
"Excessive self-blame is also one of the symptoms of depression." Lin Yanting raised his finger and tapped Han Lie from the air, "Pay attention to control."
Han Lie said "huh?" and raised his eyes to look at Lin Yanting.
"I have nothing to do, I just had a fight." Lin Yanting curled his lips and smiled, "I'm under a lot of pressure, so I have to find some opportunities to vent it out."
"Are you stressed?" Han Lie opened his eyes wide, "Are you stressed?"
Lin Yanting nodded, "Young Master Lie, it's really getting late. Do you want to go home first..." As he spoke, he nodded at the motorcycles abandoned on the ground in the distance with his chin, "Let's solve the problem first."
Han Lie looked back, hesitated, and immediately shook his head, "I'll take you to the hospital."
"Medicalhospital? Lin Yanting frowned slightly, smiled and shook the iron rod in his hand.
